capabilities.name: Deterministic public entity normalization
capabilities.description: Normalizes names and validates public organization/project/dataset/publication/registry records with evidence references.

capabilities.name: Bounded candidate matching
capabilities.description: Produces heuristic candidate matches from exact public identifiers or name similarity with explicit reason codes and pair budgets.
limitations: No automatic merge, identity assertion, calibrated probability or people matching.

explicit_non_capabilities: Social account matching or personal profiling
Sensitive attribute inference or protected-trait scoring
Automated entity merge or identity assertion
Network ingestion or external API access
